node_id.description: Unique identifier for this node in the overlay (e.g., 'node-1', 'ovr-edge-ny01'). Must not contain spaces or special characters.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging output. Use 'debug' only for troubleshooting.

state_dir.description: Directory to store runtime state, topology database, and encryption keys.

cert_dir.description: Directory containing TLS certificates and keys for node authentication.

heartbeat_interval.description: Seconds between heartbeat messages. Lower values detect failures faster but increase network traffic.

heartbeat_timeout.description: Seconds of silence before a peer is considered unreachable. Should be ≥ 3× heartbeat_interval.

encrypt_traffic.description: If true, encrypts all overlay traffic using ECIES (elliptic-curve integrated encryption). Disable only for testing.

private_key_file.description: Path to the node's ECDSA private key used for signing control-plane messages.

ca_cert_file.description: Path to the CA certificate used to verify peer certificates.

overlay_name.description: Name of the logical overlay network. Nodes must share the same overlay name to interoperate.

overlay_type.description: Overlay topology. 'mesh' allows full node-to-node connectivity; 'star' routes all traffic via hub nodes; 'hybrid' combines both.

overlay_mtu.description: Maximum Transmission Unit for overlay packets. Reduce if fragmentation occurs on underlay.

auto_discover.description: If true, automatically discovers and connects to nearby nodes using flooding/gossip. Disable for controlled topologies.

peers.description: List of static peer nodes. Required in 'star' or 'hybrid' topologies, optional otherwise for resilience.

tunnel_interface.description: Name of the virtual interface used for overlay traffic (e.g., 'ovr0'). Will be created automatically.

underlay_interface.description: Physical interface used to carry overlay traffic (encapsulated in UDP/IP).

underlay_ip.description: IP address to use as source for overlay packets. If omitted, inferred from underlay_interface.

debug.description: Debug level [0..3]. Higher values produce more verbose logs.

map_request_retries.description: Additional Map-Requests to send per map cache miss.

log_file.description: Log file path when running in daemon mode.

lisp_site.description: Allowed LISP sites for registration (MS only).

ms_static_registered_site.description: Static registered mappings for Map Server.

rloc_probe_interval.description: Seconds between RLOC probes. Set to 0 to disable.

rloc_probe_retries.description: Number of RLOC probe retries before marking locator down.

map_resolver.description: IP address(es) of Map Resolver(s), comma-separated.

static_map_cache.description: Static entries in the Map Cache.

rtr_ifaces.description: RTR interface definitions for outgoing traffic.

map_server.description: Map Server(s) to send Map-Registers to.
